Comment: Engineering Modernization Hub - modernization run state machine (Fase 1 stub). Each phase is a Pass state that only records the phase name and a placeholder status update; real Lambda integrations arrive phase by phase in Fases 2-4 per PLAN.md.

FetchRepo.Comment: Fase 2 (2.2/2.2-tf): becomes a Task invoking lambda fetch_repo, which downloads the tarball at the requested SHA and writes ws/v0 to S3.

Baseline.Comment: Fase 2 (2.3/2.3-tf): becomes a Task running the Fargate sandbox against ws/v0 to produce the baseline JUnit, persisted to S3.

DiscoveryPlan.Comment: Fase 3 (3.3-tf/3.4): becomes a Task invoking lambda agent_phase (Strands + Bedrock Haiku) for discovery, impact analysis and plan; computes plan_hash.

AwaitApproval.Comment: PLACEHOLDER ARN. Fase 4 (4.3): becomes a real callback integration using arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke.waitForTaskToken, paused until POST /runs/{id}/approval performs the conditional write (sub = requested_by, state = AWAITING_APPROVAL, plan_hash match, recent auth) and calls SendTaskSuccess/SendTaskFailure. Today this Resource ARN does not exist and this state is never actually executed end-to-end.

Implement.Comment: Fase 3 (3.8): becomes a Task invoking lambda agent_phase (Strands + Bedrock Sonnet) writing code/tests within writable_paths, through the policy gate.

Verify.Comment: Fase 2/3 (2.3-tf sandbox + 3.8 fix loop): becomes a Task running the sandbox checks (install/unit_tests/lint) and, on failure, looping back to Implement up to max_iterations.

CoreOps.Comment: Fase 2 (2.5/2.6-tf): becomes a Task invoking lambda core_ops, which computes the final verdict from real JUnit only - never from model output (CLAUDE.md invariant #1).
